name: Bearing Each Others Burdens
overview: Scripture calls believers to actively support one another by bearing each other's burdens, fulfilling the law of Christ through love and compassion. This responsibility involves restoring those who stumble with gentleness, prioritizing others' needs above our own, and exemplifying the love commanded by Christ to love our neighbors as ourselves. The example of the Good Samaritan illustrates the practical outworking of this call to care for the weak and wounded, while Paul exhorts the strong to carry the infirmities of the weak without seeking self-interest.
